title: Mangesh Pawar on LinkedIn
author: Mangesh Pawar
author_headline: President | Paints, Sealants, Fluid handling, Metered Filling and dispensing, EV Battery Assembly | Delivering ₹500Cr+ in Automotive Mfg Solutions | Graco & Binks Partner | Special Needs Parent & Inclusion Advocate
snippet:
𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿... 𝗡𝗼𝘁 𝗝𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗔𝗻𝗼𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗔𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗰𝘆.

For years, my son Aadi, who lives with Cerebral Palsy, has been my greatest teacher. 

Every challenge, every milestone and every smile has changed the way I see life.

Like every parent of a child with special needs, one question never really leaves my mind...

"What happens to him after me?"

I've come to believe that the greatest gift I can leave Aadi isn't just financial security or a trust fund.

It's a platform, a community and intellectual property that continue creating opportunities for him long after I'm gone.

That's the dream.

And I'm looking for the right creative partner to help bring it to life.

𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗜𝘀 𝗕𝗶𝗴𝗴𝗲𝗿 𝗧𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝗦𝗼𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗮. 𝗜𝘁'𝘀 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮 𝗟𝗲𝗴𝗮𝗰𝘆.

I'm looking for a freelancer, storyteller, content creator, personal branding expert or boutique agency who wants to build something meaningful over the next 2–3 years.

The vision is to build one of India's most trusted digital platforms for families raising children with special needs — a place that inspires hope, shares knowledge, celebrates abilities and creates meaningful opportunities.

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝗜'𝗺 𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗼𝗿?

A long-term creative partner who can:
• 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝗽𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆
• 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗮𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺, 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗧𝘂𝗯𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗯𝗼𝗼𝗸
• 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆
• 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗣𝗥, 𝗺𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗯𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗼𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀

More than experience, I'm looking for heart — someone who believes stories can change lives, genuinely cares about the special needs community and enjoys building something meaningful rather than chasing overnight virality.

If you're excited by challenges, love experimenting and enjoy creating things you've never done before, I'd love to hear from you.

📍 𝗠𝘂𝗺𝗯𝗮𝗶 / 𝗡𝗮𝘃𝗶 𝗠𝘂𝗺𝗯𝗮𝗶 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗯𝗲 𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗮𝗹.

This is a long-term passion project that's deeply personal to me. 

I'm looking to build a genuine partnership with someone who believes in the mission as much as the opportunity. 

I am open to a fair engagement model with a reasonable retainer initially, along with performance- and revenue-sharing as we grow together.

If this resonates with you — or if you know someone who would be a great fit — please DM me.

𝗜'𝗺 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗵𝗲𝗹𝗽 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱 𝗔𝗮𝗱𝗶'𝘀 𝗳𝘂𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲.

Sometimes the most meaningful journeys don't begin with a business plan.

They begin with a father's hope.

Perhaps this is one of them.

title: Rajiv Singh on LinkedIn
author: Rajiv Singh
author_headline: Head of Marketing at Haldiram's QSR
snippet:
We are looking to a Delhi NCR–based social media agency for managing Haldiram’s QSR social media portfolio.

We are specifically looking for an agency with proven experience in handling fresh food / QSR / restaurant brands, and with the capability to manage the mandate in an integrated manner across social media, performance marketing, campaign strategy and content creation.

Scope we are looking for:-
1. Social media management for QSR / fresh food brand pages
2. Performance marketing capabilities with a strong understanding of lead generation, reach, engagement and conversion-focused campaigns
3. In-house shoot capabilities for food photography / videography / reels / campaign content
4. Campaign ideation and strategy development aligned to brand, product and business objectives
5. Creative development and campaign execution across launches, seasonal bursts, festive campaigns and outlet-level promotions
6. Strong understanding of consumer-first storytelling in the food and QSR category

We would strongly prefer agencies that are:
1. Based in Delhi NCR
2. Already working with fresh food / QSR / restaurant / café / food retail brands
3. Equipped to operate as a strategic and execution partner, not just a page management agency.

If your agency fits the above requirement, please share your agency profile, relevant work in QSR domain, only retainer client portfolio, audit our social media page & share 6 months strategy plan on rajiv.singh@haldiram.com
